purpose: Deterministically re-expresses one caller-supplied execution receipt as two wire envelopes: a lineage RunEvent (eventType COMPLETE, eventTime from the receipt, runId derived as a pure function of the receipt's execution_hash, job namespace/name from the receipt, one input dataset per parent hash named by hash in the estate lineage-card facet dialect) and a structured-mode event envelope (specversion 1.0, id = execution_hash, type co.ainumbers.ocg.receipt.v1, time = the receipt's event time, data echoing the receipt fields unchanged). The receipt is caller-supplied and caller-asserted: the kernel never verifies the hash values, reads no clock, uses no randomness and performs no network access. Fail-closed on any missing or malformed hash, timestamp or URI-reference; a refused export carries no envelopes. Declared domain: one receipt per call, parent hashes and tool ids of equal length. Scope limits: this node does not verify receipt correctness, does not assign timestamps, and is a terminal export view: it consumes nothing and feeds nothing.
